verdict.rationale: AMD's system acceptance guide documents an 8× MI325X OAM platform (2TB HBM3) with fully-meshed Infinity Fabric between accelerators. Instinct docs add cluster-scale tooling: Cluster Validation Suite, Kubernetes GPU Operator, Slurm-compatible scheduler and cluster-wide profiling, and ROCm supplies communication primitives. missing for 10: quantified interconnect bandwidth figures, explicit rack-scale reference architecture or scale-out networking docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-node training/serving.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment

citations.quote: configuration that hosts 8 AMD Instinct MI325X OAM (OCP Accelerator Module) accelerators with a total of 2TB of HBM3 memory
It utilizes AMD’s CDNA 3 architecture with fully-meshed Infinity Fabric™ connectivity between accelerators.
Cluster Validation Suite Test scripts that validate AMD AI clusters end to end.
GPU Operator Deploy and manage Instinct GPUs in Kubernetes clusters.
Spur AI-native job scheduler, drop-in compatible with Slurm, with GPU-first scheduling and Raft-based state.
